entries.en: At three in the morning, I was still wide awake.
entries.zh: 凌晨三点，我仍然毫无睡意。

entries.en: The cupboard doors were wide open when we entered.
entries.zh: 我们进去时，橱柜的门大敞着。

entries.en: The restored film looked magnificent in its original widescreen format.
entries.zh: 修复后的影片采用原来的宽银幕格式，看起来十分壮观。

entries.en: Sharing the garden became a win-win arrangement for both neighbours.
entries.zh: 共用花园成了对两户邻居都有益的安排。

entries.en: She pushed her wind-blown hair away from her eyes.
entries.zh: 她把被风吹乱的头发从眼前拨开。

entries.en: The wisecracking driver kept us laughing through the traffic jam.
entries.zh: 那位爱说俏皮话的司机让我们在堵车时笑个不停。

entries.en: I wasn't very with it that morning and forgot my own postcode.
entries.zh: 那天上午我脑子不太清醒，连自己的邮政编码都忘了。

entries.en: She asked the adviser to explain the charges on her with-profits policy.
entries.zh: 她请顾问解释那份分红保单的收费。

entries.en: Their woman-to-woman conversation continued long after the cafe had emptied.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆里的人都走光了，她们女人间那场坦诚的谈话还在继续。

entries.en: His wrong-headed insistence on secrecy only made the misunderstanding worse.
entries.zh: 他固执地坚持保密，这种错误做法只让误会更深。

entries.en: The manager refused to tolerate yobbish behaviour in the restaurant.
entries.zh: 经理不容许有人在餐厅里举止粗野、吵吵闹闹。

entries.en: The city displayed its first zero-emission bus at the fair.
entries.zh: 市里在展会上展示了第一辆零排放公交车。

entries.en: He was zonked after the party and could barely follow our conversation.
entries.zh: 聚会后他醉得神志恍惚，几乎听不懂我们在说什么。

entries.en: My older sister is good at finding calm solutions to noisy arguments.
entries.zh: 我姐姐擅长在吵闹的争论中找出平和的解决办法。

entries.en: This ticket is good for one return journey before Sunday.
entries.zh: 这张票在星期日之前可用于一次往返行程。

entries.en: He's keen on restoring old furniture, especially wooden chairs.
entries.zh: 他热衷于修复旧家具，尤其是木椅。

entries.en: Her new found confidence showed in the way she addressed the room.
entries.zh: 从她对全场说话的方式中，可以看出她新获得的自信。

entries.en: We carried the boxes upstairs to our rented flat.
entries.zh: 我们把箱子搬上楼，搬进租来的公寓。

entries.en: The company changed its packaging but kept the familiar trade mark.
entries.zh: 公司换了包装，却保留了大家熟悉的商标。

entries.en: Her generosity was well known throughout the neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 她的慷慨在整个街区广为人知。

entries.en: We're accustomed to the church bells and rarely notice them now.
entries.zh: 我们已经习惯了教堂的钟声，如今很少注意到它们。

entries.en: From the balcony, we enjoyed a bird's eye view of the procession.
entries.zh: 我们从阳台上俯瞰了游行队伍。

entries.en: The boat was close to the wind, but the helmsman held a steady course.
entries.zh: 船几乎在迎风航行，但舵手仍保持着稳定的航向。

entries.en: Her hair trigger temper made everyone choose their words carefully.
entries.zh: 她那一触即发的脾气让大家说话都格外小心。

entries.en: Their dispute was private, and I was determined to stay out of it.
entries.zh: 他们之间的争执是私事，我决心置身事外。

entries.en: I wanted to be immersed in a book, not interrupted by messages.
entries.zh: 我想全神贯注地读一本书，而不是被消息打断。

entries.en: She seemed to be preoccupied with something and barely noticed my arrival.
entries.zh: 她似乎一心想着什么，几乎没有注意到我来了。

entries.en: That melody seemed to be reminiscent of something from his childhood.
entries.zh: 那段旋律似乎让他想起了童年的什么事。

entries.en: His flappy sleeves kept dipping into the paint.
entries.zh: 他那松松垮垮的袖子总往颜料里蘸。

entries.en: It was mean-spirited to hide her invitation just because you weren't invited.
entries.zh: 仅仅因为自己没有获邀，就藏起她的请柬，这种做法很刻薄。

entries.en: The usually chatty porter was unforthcoming about the midnight visitor.
entries.zh: 平时很健谈的门房，对那位午夜来客却不愿多说。

entries.en: We left our suitcases at the hotel in Quito and went for a walk.
entries.zh: 我们把行李箱留在基多的酒店里，出去散步了。

entries.en: The seamlessness of the scene changes impressed even the stage crew.
entries.zh: 场景切换得流畅无痕，连舞台工作人员都印象深刻。

entries.en: She spread a dropcloth over the sofa before painting the ceiling.
entries.zh: 刷天花板之前，她在沙发上铺了一块防污罩布。

entries.en: He called me a spaz for dropping the tray, and I walked away.
entries.zh: 我把托盘掉了，他就骂我是个笨蛋，于是我走开了。

entries.en: The chemist labelled the disulphide sample before placing it in storage.
entries.zh: 化学家先给那份二硫化物样品贴了标签，再将它入库。

entries.en: The novel contrasts material comfort with the unfreedom of constant surveillance.
entries.zh: 小说将物质上的舒适与无时无刻被监视的不自由作了对比。

entries.en: Her thoughtful curation brought the scattered sketches into a coherent exhibition.
entries.zh: 她精心策展，把零散的素描组合成了一场连贯的展览。

entries.en: He packed the suiter carefully before his overnight business trip.
entries.zh: 他在出发进行过夜的商务旅行前，仔细收拾了那只西服小提箱。

entries.en: The song's high tessitura tired the singer before the final verse.
entries.zh: 那首歌偏高的声域让歌手还没唱到最后一节就累了。

entries.en: A friend met us outside the hotel in Durant.
entries.zh: 一位朋友在杜兰特的酒店外与我们碰面。

entries.en: The craftswoman carved each wooden button by hand.
entries.zh: 那位女工匠手工雕刻了每一颗木纽扣。

entries.en: The crossbowman lowered his weapon when the gates opened.
entries.zh: 城门打开时，弩手放下了武器。

entries.en: A failed retransmission left the file incomplete on the receiving computer.
entries.zh: 一次失败的重传使接收电脑上的文件仍不完整。

entries.en: Her DPhil took longer than she had planned.
entries.zh: 她攻读哲学博士学位花的时间比原先计划的长。

entries.en: The dealer kept the kuan apart from the other ceramics.
entries.zh: 那位商人把官窑瓷器与其他陶瓷分开放。

entries.en: Contraflow in the two channels complicated the engineer's measurements.
entries.zh: 两个流道中的反向流动使工程师的测量变得复杂。

entries.en: Defamiliarization made the everyday kitchen objects seem strange and unsettling onstage.
entries.zh: 陌生化处理让日常厨房用品在舞台上显得陌生而令人不安。

entries.en: The lawyers disagreed about the foreseeability of the damage.
entries.zh: 律师们对损害是否具有可预见性意见不一。

entries.en: Her subnotebook fitted into a bag already crowded with books.
entries.zh: 她的小型笔记本电脑塞进了一个已经装满书的包里。

entries.en: The last microbus of the evening stopped beside the market.
entries.zh: 晚间最后一班小型公共汽车在市场旁停了下来。

entries.en: Don't call him a meathead just because he misunderstood the instructions.
entries.zh: 别因为他误解了说明，就骂他是笨蛋。

entries.en: The shipmaster waited for the passengers to board before giving the order.
entries.zh: 船长等乘客登船后才下令。

entries.meaningZh: 击出内场地滚球而出局〔棒球〕
entries.en: A groundout ended the inning and silenced the home crowd.
entries.zh: 一次内场地滚球出局结束了这一局，也让主场观众安静了下来。

entries.en: She moved the pelargonium into a larger pot.
entries.zh: 她把那株天竺葵移进了一个更大的花盆。

entries.en: The blade left a wider kerf than the carpenter expected.
entries.zh: 锯片留下的锯口比木匠预想的宽。

entries.en: The test exposed a weakness in the jacket's waterproofness.
entries.zh: 测试暴露了这件夹克防水性上的不足。

entries.en: They rested in the shade of a wingnut beside the gate.
entries.zh: 他们在门旁一棵枫杨的树荫下休息。

entries.en: Officials from the governorate attended the opening of the new library.
entries.zh: 该省的官员出席了新图书馆的开馆仪式。

entries.en: Each article required a micropayment rather than a monthly subscription.
entries.zh: 每篇文章只需付一笔小额费用，而不必按月订阅。

entries.meaningZh: 收破烂的人〔旧式职业称呼〕
entries.en: The junkman collected our broken bedframe and several bent pipes.
entries.zh: 收破烂的人收走了我们的坏床架和几根弯管子。

entries.en: The old receipt showed a price of ten cruzados.
entries.zh: 那张旧收据上的价格是十克鲁扎多。

entries.en: They put the Ouija back in its box when the lights failed.
entries.zh: 停电时，他们把占卜板放回了盒子。

entries.en: The implacability of her opposition surprised even her closest allies.
entries.zh: 她反对得如此强硬，连最亲近的盟友都感到意外。

entries.en: Eunice lent me her umbrella and walked home with her older sister.
entries.zh: 尤妮斯把伞借给了我，和姐姐一起走回家。

entries.en: They spent their last evening in Lorca writing postcards.
entries.zh: 他们在洛尔卡的最后一个晚上都在写明信片。

entries.meaningZh: 宣告猎物已死的号角声〔狩猎旧语〕
entries.en: From the distant woodland came the mort, and the riders slowed their horses.
entries.zh: 远处林中传来宣告猎物已死的号角声，骑手们放慢了马的脚步。

entries.en: The aestheticization of the ruins troubled residents who remembered the destruction.
entries.zh: 把废墟审美化的做法，让那些记得破坏情景的居民感到不安。

entries.en: The oppositionist demanded a public debate rather than another closed meeting.
entries.zh: 那位反对派成员要求公开辩论，而不是再开一次闭门会议。

entries.en: He left a glass of water on the bedstand.
entries.zh: 他在床头柜上放了一杯水。

entries.en: The belatedness of the apology hurt more than the original mistake.
entries.zh: 道歉来得太晚，这比最初的错误更让人难过。

entries.en: She rewrote the sestina until its repeated words felt effortless.
entries.zh: 她反复修改那首六节诗，直到那些重复的词读起来毫不生硬。

entries.meaningZh: 迫切想要的事物〔拉丁语借词，复数〕
entries.en: A quiet room and reliable heating topped her list of desiderata.
entries.zh: 一间安静的房间和可靠的供暖设备，是她最迫切想要的东西。

entries.en: The scanner's misrecognition of one letter changed the entire surname.
entries.zh: 扫描仪把一个字母识别错了，整个姓氏都变了。

entries.en: They donated a trunkful of winter clothes to the shelter.
entries.zh: 他们向收容所捐了满满一箱冬衣。

entries.meaningZh: 世外桃源般的地方〔文学用语〕
entries.en: The secluded cottage became her private xanadu during the summer.
entries.zh: 那间僻静小屋成了她夏日里的私人世外桃源。

entries.en: The neighbours complained when the kegger spilled onto the front lawn.
entries.zh: 啤酒聚会的人群扩到了前院草坪上，邻居们为此投诉了。

entries.en: His admiring whew echoed down the empty hallway.
entries.zh: 他赞叹的口哨声在空荡荡的走廊里回响。

entries.meaningZh: 出征前涂在身面上的颜料〔历史用语〕
entries.en: The actor wiped the warpaint from his face after the final scene.
entries.zh: 最后一场戏结束后，演员擦掉了脸上的出征彩绘颜料。

entries.en: The proposed megadeal collapsed when the two companies could not agree on a price.
entries.zh: 两家公司无法就价格达成一致，拟议中的巨额交易因此告吹。

entries.en: An error in the germline data delayed the team's analysis.
entries.zh: 种系数据中的一个错误拖延了团队的分析工作。

entries.en: The ritualization of their morning coffee gave structure to otherwise chaotic days.
entries.zh: 把晨间喝咖啡变成固定仪式，让他们原本混乱的日子有了章法。

entries.en: A trail of seaweed marked the tideline across the beach.
entries.zh: 一线海藻在沙滩上标出了潮汐线。

entries.en: We arranged to meet our friends in Spandau after lunch.
entries.zh: 我们约好午饭后在施潘道与朋友见面。

entries.en: The developer tested feature enablement on a spare laptop.
entries.zh: 开发人员在一台备用笔记本电脑上测试了功能启用。

entries.en: She accepted the superintendency after years of work in the district.
entries.zh: 在该地区工作多年后，她接受了主管职位。

entries.en: He rinsed the zester and hung it beside the other utensils.
entries.zh: 他冲洗了刨皮器，把它挂在其他厨具旁边。

entries.en: Her fieldwork in archaeoastronomy involved long days measuring the ruined enclosure.
entries.zh: 她在考古天文学方面的田野工作，需要长时间测量那处围墙遗址。

entries.en: The sauce's fruitiness balanced the sharp taste of the cheese.
entries.zh: 酱汁浓郁的果味平衡了奶酪浓烈的味道。

entries.meaningZh: 优生学家〔主张争议性优生理论者〕
entries.en: The novel's eugenicist loses support when the cruelty of his scheme becomes clear.
entries.zh: 小说中那位优生学家的方案显露出残酷本质后，他失去了支持。

entries.en: I checked her filmography before choosing a film for the retrospective.
entries.zh: 我先查了她的全部影片目录，再为回顾展选片。

entries.en: His bossiness turned a friendly game into an unpleasant contest.
entries.zh: 他的专横跋扈把一场友谊赛变成了令人不快的较量。

entries.en: The king's claim to godhood is challenged in the final act.
entries.zh: 那位国王自称为神的说法，在最后一幕中受到了挑战。

entries.meaningZh: 解除思想灌输的人员〔有争议的称谓〕
entries.en: The family hired a deprogrammer, but she refused to meet him.
entries.zh: 家人雇了一名解除思想灌输的人员，但她拒绝与他见面。

entries.en: They rented a room in Williamsburg while their house was being repaired.
entries.zh: 房子维修期间，他们在威廉斯堡租了一个房间。

entries.en: The technician replaced the damaged photodiode before testing the detector again.
entries.zh: 技术员换掉受损的光电二极管后，再次测试了探测器。

entries.meaningZh: 古代斯堪的纳维亚吟唱诗人
entries.en: The skald in her story refuses the king's reward.
entries.zh: 她故事里的那位古代斯堪的纳维亚吟唱诗人拒绝了国王的赏赐。

entries.en: We crossed the Mander just before sunset.
entries.zh: 我们在日落前刚刚渡过曼德河。

entries.en: Her elaborate upsweep came loose halfway through the dance.
entries.zh: 舞会进行到一半，她精心梳起的高髻松开了。

entries.en: The young boxer was a basher, relying on force rather than timing.
entries.zh: 那位年轻拳手是个猛打型选手，靠的是蛮力而不是时机。

entries.meaningZh: 夏威夷古神殿〔夏威夷语借词〕
entries.en: Visitors waited quietly outside the heiau while the guide spoke.
entries.zh: 导游讲解时，游客们在那座夏威夷古神殿外安静地等着。

entries.en: She poured a ladleful of soup into each bowl.
entries.zh: 她往每个碗里盛了一满勺汤。

entries.en: The loose cable between the microphone and preamplifier caused an annoying crackle.
entries.zh: 麦克风与前置放大器之间的线缆松了，发出恼人的噼啪声。

entries.meaningZh: 资产阶级女性〔法语借词〕
entries.en: The novel's heroine is a wealthy bourgeoise who envies the aristocracy.
entries.zh: 小说的女主人公是一位羡慕贵族的富裕资产阶级女性。

entries.en: The novel follows a kulak whose farm is seized.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一个农场被没收的富农的经历。

entries.en: He found a minidisc containing an interview he thought he had lost.
entries.zh: 他找到一张微型碟片，里面有一段他以为已经丢失的采访。

entries.en: She left the cyberworld behind for a weekend without screens.
entries.zh: 她暂时告别网络世界，度过了一个不看屏幕的周末。

entries.en: The referee checked the scoresheet before announcing the winner.
entries.zh: 裁判核对了记分单后，宣布了获胜者。

entries.en: Rien left a spare key with the neighbour before travelling.
entries.zh: 连出门旅行前，在邻居那里留了一把备用钥匙。

entries.en: The twins cherished their twoness but hated being treated as interchangeable.
entries.zh: 那对双胞胎珍视彼此成双的联系，却讨厌被当作可以互相替代的人。

entries.en: The horse lifted one hindleg as the groom brushed its flank.
entries.zh: 马夫刷马的侧腹时，那匹马抬起了一条后腿。

entries.en: A hailer on the quay shouted for the departing boat to return.
entries.zh: 码头上一位呼喊的人大声叫那艘正在离开的船回来。

entries.en: The shopkeepers refused to accept the gang's intimidation and gangsterism.
entries.zh: 店主们拒绝屈服于那个团伙的恐吓和强盗行径。

entries.en: A vanload of donated books arrived before the sale began.
entries.zh: 义卖开始前，一货车捐来的书运到了。

entries.meaningZh: 信息技术精英〔集合称呼〕
entries.en: The digerati crowded around the prototype while other guests headed for lunch.
entries.zh: 信息技术精英们围着原型机，其他客人则去吃午饭了。

entries.meaningZh: 切成细丝的蔬菜〔烹饪法语借词〕
entries.en: A small mound of chiffonade rested beside the finished dish.
entries.zh: 做好菜的旁边放着一小堆切成细丝的蔬菜。

entries.en: The driver noticed understeer during the test and returned to the garage.
entries.zh: 司机在测试中发现转向不足，便返回了修车厂。

entries.en: The storm left broken branches scattered along the shorefront.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，沿岸陆地上散落着折断的树枝。

entries.en: My older brother sent the parcel from Tulsa on Monday.
entries.zh: 我哥哥星期一从塔尔萨寄出了包裹。

entries.en: Her strict textualism left little room for alternative readings of the passage.
entries.zh: 她严格拘守原文，几乎不容许对那段文字作其他解读。

entries.en: The artist polished the greenstone until its surface caught the light.
entries.zh: 艺术家打磨那块软玉，直到它的表面映出光泽。

entries.en: They planted a mahonia beside the garden wall.
entries.zh: 他们在花园墙边种了一株十大功劳。

entries.meaningZh: 男同性恋者〔澳式侮辱性俚语〕
entries.en: When the bully called him a poofter, his friends challenged the slur.
entries.zh: 那个恶霸用侮辱同性恋的脏话骂他时，他的朋友们出面反驳了。

entries.en: There was a steeliness beneath her polite refusal.
entries.zh: 她礼貌的拒绝中透着一股顽强固执。

entries.en: The unsustainability of the schedule became obvious when half the staff resigned.
entries.zh: 一半员工辞职后，这种排班无法持续就显而易见了。

entries.en: The kitchen smelled of toasted cummin and warm bread.
entries.zh: 厨房里弥漫着烘烤孜然和热面包的香气。

entries.en: The damaged bilayer could no longer be used for the experiment.
entries.zh: 那个受损的双分子层已经不能再用于实验。

entries.en: Her criticism of economism angered the party's younger members.
entries.zh: 她对经济主义的批评激怒了党内的年轻成员。

entries.en: The old townsite lay beyond the abandoned railway station.
entries.zh: 旧城址位于那座废弃火车站的另一边。

entries.meaningZh: 没头脑的人〔美式贬义俚语〕
entries.en: She resented being dismissed as a ditz whenever she asked a question.
entries.zh: 她一提问就被当成没头脑的人，因此很不满。

entries.meaningZh: 比女友年轻得多的男伴〔非正式〕
entries.en: She disliked the neighbours calling her partner a toyboy.
entries.zh: 她不喜欢邻居把她的伴侣叫作“小情郎”。

entries.en: Spokespeople for both groups waited outside the meeting room.
entries.zh: 双方的发言人都在会议室外等候。

entries.en: The bright parafoil lay folded beside the rest of the equipment.
entries.zh: 那顶鲜艳的翼伞叠放在其余装备旁边。

entries.en: She scattered a palmful of seed across the bare patch.
entries.zh: 她在那块光秃秃的地上撒了一手心的种子。

entries.en: The privatizer faced sharp questions from workers worried about their jobs.
entries.zh: 那位主张私有化的人遭到了担心失业的工人们的尖锐质问。

entries.en: Willa rescued the cake just before it slid off the plate.
entries.zh: 蛋糕快要滑出盘子时，威拉一把接住了它。

entries.en: They shared a bowl of spumoni after the long afternoon walk.
entries.zh: 漫长的午后散步结束后，他们分吃了一碗意大利冰糕。

entries.en: I felt like a numbskull after locking my keys inside again.
entries.zh: 又把钥匙锁在里面后，我觉得自己真是个笨蛋。

entries.en: A servant carried cates and wine into the crowded hall.
entries.zh: 一名仆人把佳肴和葡萄酒送进挤满人的大厅。

entries.en: The chef added enoki to the bowl just before serving.
entries.zh: 厨师在上菜前往碗里加了些朴蘑。

entries.en: The caller's abusiveness prompted the receptionist to end the conversation.
entries.zh: 来电者满口辱骂，接待员因此结束了通话。

entries.en: The payslip showed a union checkoff beside the other deductions.
entries.zh: 工资单在其他扣款旁列出了工会会费代扣款。

entries.en: The scientificity of the study suffered from its poorly documented methods.
entries.zh: 这项研究的方法记录不充分，损害了其科学性。

entries.en: She tucked a small pomander among the folded linen.
entries.zh: 她在叠好的亚麻布中放了一只小香球。

entries.en: Several pots of Nymphaea stood beside the pond.
entries.zh: 几盆睡莲属植物摆在池塘旁边。

entries.en: The wind left her hair in a state of cheerful dishevelment.
entries.zh: 风把她的头发吹得蓬松凌乱，显得活泼随意。

entries.en: She ordered a sandwich with mortadella and a slice of cheese.
entries.zh: 她点了一个夹着摩泰台拉香肚和一片奶酪的三明治。

entries.en: Medici waited beside the entrance with a folded umbrella.
entries.zh: 美第奇拿着一把收好的伞，在入口旁等候。

entries.en: Our resident fussbudget complained that the cushions no longer matched.
entries.zh: 我们这里那个爱大惊小怪的人抱怨说，靠垫已经不配套了。

entries.en: The goodwife set another bowl by the hearth.
entries.zh: 那位主妇在炉边又放下了一只碗。

entries.en: The stage designer's literalization of the poem produced an enormous wooden heart.
entries.zh: 舞台设计师按字面理解那首诗，做出了一颗巨大的木心。

entries.meaningZh: 落地反弹后击球〔球类运动〕
entries.en: Her powerful groundstroke forced her opponent back towards the baseline.
entries.zh: 她有力的一记落地球把对手逼回了底线附近。

entries.en: He twirled the capellini around his fork and tasted the sauce.
entries.zh: 他用叉子卷起天使细面，尝了尝酱汁。

entries.en: The weaver selected red shute for her next length of cloth.
entries.zh: 织工为下一段布选了红色纬纱。

entries.en: Remington offered to carry the heavier box upstairs.
entries.zh: 雷明顿主动提出把较重的箱子搬上楼。

entries.en: The apparent determinacy of the answer vanished when we changed one assumption.
entries.zh: 我们改变一个假设后，答案原本显出的确定性就消失了。

entries.en: Macy saved the last slice of pie for her younger brother.
entries.zh: 梅西把最后一块派留给了弟弟。

entries.en: The revanchist rejected every compromise offered during the negotiations.
entries.zh: 那位复仇主义者拒绝了谈判中提出的一切妥协方案。

entries.en: Jonny remembered the tickets just as we reached the door.
entries.zh: 我们刚走到门口，乔尼就想起了那些票。

entries.en: A narrow path followed the ghyll beneath the trees.
entries.zh: 一条小径沿着树下的溪谷延伸。

entries.en: In the tale, a deva appears beside the traveller's fire.
entries.zh: 故事中，一位天神出现在旅人的篝火旁。

entries.en: She bought a Casio and wore it to her first swimming lesson.
entries.zh: 她买了一块卡西欧手表，戴着去上了第一堂游泳课。

entries.en: The class gathered outside the oceanarium before the doors opened.
entries.zh: 开门前，全班同学就在大型水族馆外集合了。

entries.meaningZh: 高级市政官〔苏格兰市政官称谓〕
entries.en: The bailie listened to the merchants' complaint about the market.
entries.zh: 那位高级市政官听取了商人们对市场的投诉。

entries.en: His inarticulateness hid a deep affection that his letters finally revealed.
entries.zh: 他因不善言辞而未能表露的深情，最终在那些信里流露出来。
